definitions.explanation: The compass direction midway between south and east.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{南東|なんとう}の{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}く。
examples.english: In summer a southeast wind blows.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}が{南東|なんとう}を{向|む}いているので{朝日|あさひ}がよく{入|はい}る。
examples.english: The window faces southeast, so the morning sun comes in well.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}は{南東|なんとう}の{海上|かいじょう}から{北|きた}へ{進|すす}む{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to move north from the sea to the southeast.

notes:
Composed of {南|なん} (south) + {東|とう} (east). One of the four intercardinal directions. A south-facing to southeast-facing ({南東|なんとう}{向|む}き) home is prized in Japan for its good morning and daytime sunlight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南東|なんとう}の{風|かぜ}: southeast wind
- {南東|なんとう}に{位置|いち}する: to be located to the southeast
- {南東|なんとう}{方向|ほうこう}: southeast direction
- {南東部|なんとうぶ}: southeastern part/region

RELATED COMPASS DIRECTIONS:
- {北東|ほくとう}: northeast
- {北西|ほくせい}: northwest
- {南西|なんせい}: southwest
